edited_dev.why: configures the db logger in logconf/dev.ini, the fuller file, which the service doesn't start with

dev_made_default.why: configures the db logger in dev.ini, then makes APP_ENV default to dev so the live service loads it

db_log_in_code.why: sets the db logger's level and db.log handler in setup_logging's code instead of in the live prod.ini
